name: Oinusama Harama SEX
source:
A short heartwarming bestiality SLG. 
Feed the doggy girl and earn her trust and loyalty.
Different endings based on copulations and amount of friendship. 

18 base CGs (3 of which have Live2D animation) 
5 endings 
Created with Unity Utage

Includes features like: 
CG appreciation 
H scene replay 
Message window transparency 
Simple tap play for smartphones 
Up to 1280x720 display option 
Customizable protagonist name 
and more 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE178435.html]DLsite English[/url]]
